account.title: Account
account.addLanguageHint: Each language keeps its own level, vocabulary, history and settings.
account.alreadyAdded: You have already added that language.
account.noMoreLanguages: You have added every language this app offers.
account.added: Added {language}. Switch to it when you are ready.

home.streakNone: Start today to begin a streak!
home.historyHint: Review past sessions, replay any day
home.howItWorks: Your trainer builds one reading · vocab · writing · listening · speaking session a day, tuned to your level. Tapped words are learned with spaced repetition, and tomorrow's lesson is queued automatically.

session.title: Daily session
session.warmupNone: No words due right now. Great job keeping on top of them!
session.answersSaved: Your answers will be saved as you continue.
session.writingHint: Write about your own life — this model sentence only shows the pattern to use. Don't copy it verbatim.
session.writeOwn: Write your own sentence in {lang} (any topic using the same structure)
session.queuedGrading: Sent for grading — feedback will appear shortly.
session.recording: Recording — read it out loud, then tap stop.
session.transcriptPlaceholder: Type what you said if microphone recognition is unavailable
session.httpsRequired: Recording needs HTTPS and a supported browser.
session.grading: Grading in progress — check back in a moment.
session.writingTryPattern: — try the same pattern with your own details (family, hobbies, plans…).
session.recordingPrivacy: 🔒 Your recording stays on this trainer and is only used for feedback. It is auto-deleted after the retention period.

practice.title: Practice
practice.transcribePlaceholder: Speak it, or type or paste what you said
practice.httpsRequired: Recording needs HTTPS and a supported browser — you can attach a file below.
practice.gradingInProgress: Grading in progress — check back in a moment.
practice.submittedFeedback: Submitted — feedback will appear after grading.
practice.bandGreat: Great job — you covered nearly the whole sentence.
practice.bandClose: Close — a syllable or two didn't come through.
practice.bandRough: Roughly there — keep practising for a smoother read.
practice.bandLow: Not quite — try again slowly, syllable by syllable.

words.nothingNew: Nothing new found — your list already covers the topic.
words.noMatch: No words match — tap words while reading to grow your list.
words.discoverHint: Ask the trainer for fresh vocabulary to grow your list.

progress.title: Progress
progress.noSessions: No sessions yet. Finished your first one today?
progress.everyLitDay: Every lit day is a completed session.
progress.tableNote: Each row is one day's session. Scores are % correct; — means that skill was skipped.

history.title: History
history.intro: Every completed day, reopened read-only exactly as it happened — your answers, corrections and scores.
history.empty: No completed sessions yet. Finish a daily session and it will show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetWarning: Reset ALL progress: every session, word, writing entry and speaking attempt is deleted, your level returns to {level} and the streak is cleared. Voice/speed settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetConfirm: Reset ALL progress? This deletes every session, word, writing entry and speaking attempt, sets your level back to {level} and clears the streak. Voice/speed settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetDone: Progress reset — you are ready to start from scratch.

srs.recallHint: Try to recall what this word means before revealing it.
srs.howWell: How well did you know it?
